children: Fusemachines entered into a Securities Purchase Agreement to issue up to 2,138,935 common shares to certain vendors and service providers in exchange for approximately $1.30 million of accrued fees. The per-share price is $0.6103, based on the five-day VWAP on the Nasdaq Global Market prior to closing, with issuance expected around September 14, 2026. No cash proceeds will be received; the transaction cancels outstanding payables. The company will file a resale registration statement as soon as practicable and seek effectiveness within 90 days.
: Securities Purchase Agreement for stock issuance to settle payables
: Settle accrued fees and strengthen liquidity
